A Homecoming to Alhambra: Cathay Bank Returns to 601 North Atlantic Boulevard


angela.wan+a


Fri, 08/21/2026 - 15:58


Cathay Bank is proud to announce the return of its Alhambra Branch to 601 North Atlantic Boulevard, a location that represents an important part of the Bank's history and longstanding connection to the community.


Originally designed and built by Cathay Bank in 1985, the branch was created to reflect both the Bank's heritage and its commitment to serving the growing San Gabriel Valley community. Over the years, the building has become a recognizable local landmark, known for its distinctive, green-tiled roof and Asian-inspired architectural design.


More than just a branch location, 601 North Atlantic Boulevard stands as a reflection of the cultural roots, entrepreneurial spirit, and community-focused values that have guided Cathay Bank since its founding. Its unique design continues to symbolize the Bank's commitment to honoring its heritage while evolving to meet the needs of future generations.


“We are proud to return to a location that represents an important chapter in Cathay Bank's history,” said **Chang M. Liu** , President and Chief Executive Officer of Cathay Bank. “This relocation reflects our continued commitment to serving our clients and communities while honoring the legacy that has contributed to the Bank's growth. We look forward to welcoming clients to this historic branch and continuing to provide the personalized service and trusted financial solutions they have come to expect from Cathay Bank.”


The grand opening ceremony was attended by senior leadership and community members who gathered to commemorate this significant occasion for Cathay Bank.


Cathay Bank looks forward to welcoming both longtime clients and new generations of customers to the Alhambra Branch. As the Bank returns to this iconic location, it remains dedicated to building lasting relationships and supporting the growth and success of the community for years to come.
